verdict.rationale: Pendo documents REST APIs, such as the bulk-delete endpoint and REST track events, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and no evidence pack item mentions a downloadable spec. The llms.txt file is a documentation index, not a machine-readable API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
